kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: A year ago, President Trump pledged to lower Medicaid drug prices. Has that happened?
wire.summary: The Trump administration's efforts to lower drug prices included promised changes to Medicaid. But it's still unclear which drugs will be affected. And each state has to opt in.

wire.title: 'American Scoundrel' traces Roy Cohn's playbook from McCarthyism to Trump
wire.summary: In Kai Bird's biography of Cohn, he looks at how the lawyer taught Trump how to deny, delay, attack, sue and countersue, never admit defeat, side-step paying bills and avoid a paper trail.

wire.title: Greetings from Beijing, where baozi are worth the wait in line
wire.summary: The popular fluffy steamed buns are filled with pork, vegetables, tofu — and in one trendy Beijing shop, chocolate and red beans.

wire.title: U.N.-backed experts cite possible U.S. war crimes in Iran, including a school attack
wire.summary: Human rights experts commissioned by the U.N. say they have found "reasonable grounds" to believe the U.S. committed war crimes in Iran, including a strike on a school in the southern city of Minab.

wire.title: The Fed raises interest rates. And, EU proposes Canada become an 'associate member'
wire.summary: The Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time in years. And, the European Union has proposed that Canada become its first-ever "associate member."

wire.title: Pressure on global chokepoints drives Asia's increased use of Arctic Trade Routes
wire.summary: Asian nations began pilot voyages over a decade ago to find routes to Europe and the Middle East that were faster and less vulnerable to chokepoints. The ongoing war has added impetus to those efforts.

wire.title: Why reshaping memories may hold the key to raising self-esteem
wire.summary: In a new book, psychologist Marisa Franco explains why it's good to feel good about yourself — and shares a helpful memory technique that we've turned into a printable worksheet.

wire.title: D.C. airspace is complicated. Experts say Trump's arch would add one more risk
wire.summary: The Trump administration wants to build its 250-foot arch near one of the country's busiest runways. The FAA will determine whether that poses a hazard. But independent experts already have concerns.

wire.title: A Sikh truck driver is stabbed amid a rise in anti-South Asian rhetoric
wire.summary: The driver said he was shaken by a violent encounter at a rest stop, which he described as unprovoked.

wire.title: People's houses are collapsing into the ocean. FEMA gives them no other option
wire.summary: Waterfront homes are collapsing along the coast. Homeowners generally have plenty of warning before their house buckles. So why aren't most houses removed, or at least emptied, before they fall?

wire.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
wire.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said a Canada-EU alliance would create a "beacon for other democracies".

wire.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
wire.summary: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.

wire.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
wire.summary: Austin Tice’s abduction was approved by Syria’s former leader Bashar al-Assad, a source claims.

wire.title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
wire.summary: Mustafa Suleyman says he believes rival AI firm Anthropic is in effect teaching Claude it "may be conscious".

wire.title: Swedish PM Kristersson resigns after election loss
wire.summary: Left-wing opposition parties led by Magdalena Andersson look set to form the next government.

wire.title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
wire.summary: Under the plans, only children over 15 would be able to set up their own social media accounts.
